import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0213 (l : List Nat) : l.sum = (l.tail).sum + l.headOption.get_or_else 0 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0213 (l : List Nat) : l.sum = (l.tail).sum + l.headOption.get_or_else 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [List.sum_nil, List.tail_nil, List.headOption_nil, List.get_or_else_zero]
  | cons h t ih =>
    simp [List.sum_cons, List.tail_cons, List.headOption_cons, List.get_or_else_cons, ih]
    (h + (t.sum + List.get_or_else_zero)) = (h + (t.tail.sum + List.get_or_else_zero)) + List.get_or_else_zero
  exact (h + (t.tail.sum + List.get_or_else_zero)) + List.get_or_else_zero = (h + (t.tail.sum + List.get_or_else_zero)) + List.get_or_else_zero

END BY
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0213 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0213 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0213

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0213
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0213
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
